limitations: Primary Routing.Rule vs Engine imported-claim handoff causes safe false-abstention ('Primary could not resolve a source for this request.') when an imported fact subject contains a procedure keyword (e.g., 'restore', 'configure', 'guide', 'recovery') even though Research & Verification marks the claim 'supported' (12/13 custodian blind outcome suite).

Original native CPU model stays shadow-only (54/72 on public synthetic routing, tied with linear baseline); no learned policy promotion authorized.
